page: Microsoft Azure EC8as_v6 is an ECasv6-family virtual machine configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this server utilizes AMD processors and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware allocation provides a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU, positioning it within the memory-optimized category.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached storage. It is designated as Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance persistent disks. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses bundled with this configuration.

With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the EC8as_v6 is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local temporary storage. Suitable workloads include relational databases, in-memory caching layers, and data analytics tasks that fit within a 64.0 GB memory footprint. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance for these applications.
